The prospective structural object is a single regenerative renewal unit. A renewal creates exactly eight physical ticks of unit service; afterward service is zero until another renewal. A real renewal costs two service-tick units. Long-run direct return is service minus renewal cost per physical tick. There is no task content, mark, hidden state, safety event, learning, discount, checkpoint, terminal boundary, or sampling error. One equal-physical-time stratum has a real opportunity every tick and the other every four ticks. Both policy families receive the same physical slots, opportunity flags, and exposure values; non-opportunity slots are matched dummy calls that cannot act or affect return.

All probabilities use the frozen rational grid `Q={0/16,1/16,...,16/16}`. A diagnostic may choose a separate constant event probability in each stratum. The deployed per-opportunity family chooses one `p` and uses it at both spacings. The deployed exposure-linked family chooses one base per-tick probability `r`, using event probability `r` at spacing one and `1-(1-r)^4` at spacing four, which for interior `r` is equivalent to `u(e)=1-exp(-lambda e)`. Exact ties prefer lower mean physical event rate and then the lower grid index. KEEP never renews. A payload-null real-action shell uses exactly a candidate's event probabilities and action costs but does not reset service age.

The proposed regenerative identity is `J_Delta(q)=1-(1-q)^(8/Delta)-2q/Delta`, with `J_Delta(0)=0`, for spacings one and four. Please derive or refute it from the stated process rather than accepting it. The exact observational unit is the clock stratum, and global-family performance is the equal mean of the two stratum returns. The frozen direct-return margin is `1/32`; the robust event-probability separation margin is `1/4`; and a stratum's near-optimal set contains grid values within `1/64` direct return of its best value. Headroom requires each stratum's unrestricted best to beat both KEEP and its matched shell by more than `1/32`. Robust heterogeneity requires interior optima and at least `1/4` separation between the two near-optimal sets. Only after those gates should the two global families be compared: a margin greater than `1/32` in either direction is material, otherwise the result is no material link difference.
